title: glandularia angustilobata
intro: Glandularia angustilobata, commonly known as Purple Sage, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the verbena family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Glandularia angustilobata include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, and provide relaxation and calming effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic value.
